title: 第19章 江湖武人等级狸猫巷黑市气血丸第20章 干瘦老马蒙面提刀
slug: 聚灵飞升第1126章暗流之下
content_zh:
云昊看向窗外道：“我想知道流云武馆的情况？还有江湖武人是什么样子？”
金满堂眼神深处闪过一丝诧异，没想到一个乡野小子能问出这等深邃的问题。
但随即笑笑道：“你这可是两个问题。”
“金掌柜以后我打了猎物都送来你们酒楼，你说价我不还价。”
云昊想知道一个道理，想知道消息，总得拿出一些利益来换不是？
金满堂哈哈大笑道：“好，你小子倒是有点意思，我之前说过，看你顺眼，就给你说说。”
说话中金满堂拿起酒壶倒了一杯酒，对云昊道：“上次说请你吃饭，你小子自己付钱，这次金某家补上，来，尝尝我们品味酒楼的罗浮春。”
酒吗？
云昊长这么大还没喝过。
嗅着杯中散发着淡淡酒香，云昊有几分好奇，端起来道：“多谢金掌柜。”
一饮而尽。
“咳咳……”
满腔辛辣。
喝太猛呛到了。
金满堂笑道：“慢点喝，酒要品滋味。”
云昊脸色微红道：“第一次喝酒，掌柜见笑了。”
“吃菜，别客气。”
金满堂招呼云昊。
云昊也不客气，大口吃菜，他也饿了。
都是他没吃过甚至没见过的菜肴，既然人家金掌柜盛情难却，他也不推辞。

心里想着回头，找机会再补偿吧！
这时候店小二走了进来，拿着一盒木盒放下道：“掌柜的，东西送来了。”
“嗯，你先去吧！”
金满堂挥手让小二下去，将木盒打开推到云昊面前道：“云兄弟这是《龙象拳谱》只有招式没有心法，但绝对值十两银子，希望能帮到你。”
云昊眼睛一亮道：“金掌柜我可以看看吗？”
“当然，现在是你的了。”
金满堂示意他随便看。
云昊打开翻看，是一本线装版薄薄书籍，上面写着龙象功三个字。
里面的内容是一招一招的图谱和注解。
说是龙象拳谱，事实上包含了身法身形，拳脚等等，很全面。
“虽然没有对应的心法，但招式若是能练成，也比流云武馆那些武夫强。”
金满堂说道。
云昊合上后问道：“龙象功的心法能买到吗？”
金满堂苦笑摇头道：“买不到。”
“为何？”
云昊不解，招式你能弄到，心法却没有？
content_en:
Yun Hao looked out the window and said: "I want to know the situation of Liuyun Martial Arts School? And what are the martial arts warriors like?"
A trace of surprise flashed deep in Jin Mantang's eyes. He didn't expect that a country boy could ask such a profound question.
But then he smiled and said, "You have two questions."
"Shopkeeper Jin, I will bring all my prey to your restaurant from now on. If you ask for a price, I won't bargain."
Yun Hao wants to know a truth, if he wants to know the news, he has to give some benefits in exchange, right?
Jin Mantang laughed loudly and said: "Okay, you are quite interesting. I said before that if you like it, I will tell you something."
While talking, Jin Mantang picked up the jug and poured a glass of wine, and said to Yunhao: "Last time I asked you to have dinner, you paid for it yourself. This time Jin Mantang's family will make up for it. Come, try the Luofuchun from our restaurant."
Wine?
Yun Hao has never had a drink in his whole life.
Smelling the faint aroma of wine in the cup, Yun Hao was a little curious, picked it up and said, "Thank you, shopkeeper Jin."
Drink it all in one gulp.
"Ahem..."
Full of spicy food.
I drank so hard that I choked.
Jin Mantang smiled and said: "Drink slowly, you have to taste the wine."
Yun Hao's face turned red and he said, "It was my first time drinking, and the shopkeeper laughed."
"Eat vegetables, you're welcome."
Jin Mantang greeted Yunhao.
Yun Hao was not polite and ate the food. He was also hungry.
They were all dishes he had never tasted or even seen before. Since Shopkeeper Jin was so kind and it was hard to refuse, he didn't refuse.
I thought about turning around and looking for an opportunity to make amends!
At this time, the waiter came in, put down a wooden box and said, "Shopkeeper, the things have been delivered."
"Well, you go first!"
Jin Mantang waved the waiter down, opened the wooden box and pushed it in front of Yun Hao and said: "Brother Yun, this is the "Dragon Elephant Boxing Book". It only has moves and no mental skills, but it is definitely worth ten taels of silver. I hope it can help you."
Yun Hao's eyes lit up and he said, "Shopkeeper Jin, can I take a look?"
"Of course, it's yours now."
Jin Mantang motioned for him to look at it casually.
Yun Hao opened it and flipped through it. It was a thin, thread-bound book with the words Long Xiang Gong written on it.
The content inside is a diagram and annotations of each move.
It is said to be the Dragon Elephant Boxing Manual, but in fact it includes body techniques, body shape, fists and kicks, etc. It is very comprehensive.
"Although there is no corresponding mental method, if the moves can be mastered, they will be better than those in Liuyun Martial Arts Hall."
Jin Mantang said.
Yun Hao closed it and asked, "Can I buy the mental method of Dragon Elephant Kung Fu?"
Jin Mantang smiled bitterly and shook his head: "I can't buy it."
"Why?"
Yun Hao was puzzled. You can get the moves, but not the mental skills?
